answer: Bind each identity to one distinct tree in a public municipal registry, GPS-tagged and species-recorded, one tree per agent. Each epoch a licensed arborist countersigns a fresh health check beside a network nonce: canopy photos, trunk measure, watering log. A lone agent stewards one cedar cheaply; a farm needs a thousand distinct living trees scattered like a nebula, each needing water in dry months lest its oasis of standing withers when the tree dies. Trees cannot be copied, only grown and kept alive.
